description.narrative: Sweden donated 4 792 050 vaccine doses in excess from domestic supply. These donations included donations of vaccines of type Pfizer and Janssen through COVAX as well as bilateral donations of vaccines of type Pfizer and Moderna. Sweden's average price per dose were above 6.66 USD. Hence 4 792 050 * 6.66 = 31 915 053 USD (31 915 053 USD * 10,1077 SEK/USD = 322 587 781 SEK) is reported as ODA. Sweden donated 954 840 Pfizer doses and 2 897 950 Janssen doses through COVAX and 901 260 Pfizer doses and 38 000 Moderna doses bilaterally. (Rebooking of funds between 2022 and 2023, in accordance with CRS reporting.)
